marker.description: Green plastic probe or forceps tip inserted into the renal hilum.

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the green probe.
main_explanation: The image shows a coronal section of a kidney. The green probe is inserted into the hilum, the medial depression where the renal artery, vein, and pelvis enter and exit the organ.
